claims.text: The paper introduces new metrics for evaluating multi-span question answering systems, including partial match precision, recall, and F1 scores.
The evaluation metrics are designed to measure the overlap between predicted spans and ground truth answers, using the length of the longest common substring.
The proposed metrics aim to assess multi-span QA systems across different tasks, reflecting a more realistic QA setup.
